entities.summary: Friedrich Karl Walter Degenhard Freiherr von Loë was a Prussian soldier and aristocrat. Loë had the distinction of being one of the few Roman Catholics to reach the rank of Generalfeldmarschall in the Prussian and imperial German armies.
